title: Guardrail Placement against Prompt Injection in Retrieval-Augmented Agricultural Advisory Systems: Benchmark and Code
description: Benchmark, code, and raw results for the study of guardrail placement against direct and indirect prompt injection in a retrieval-augmented agricultural-economics advisory assistant. The release covers eight guardrail configurations (including Meta Llama Prompt Guard 2, spotlighting, output rails, and retrieved-document screening) on three language models, Studies S1 to S8, and the human validation of the LLM judges. Version 2.0.0 accompanies the revised manuscript.
